killedBy: moment recipes naming developer arms (issue #775) carries a recipe's arrival arm into the respawn moment's page request, and nothing without it
why: The forwarding #775 adds. Without it a recipe that names `arrival: opposed` still validates, still records the arm it asked for, and captures the shipped language -- the silent no-op the gallery's own refusals exist to prevent. The provenance check in the same adapter would also catch it on a real run; this entry pins the argv half, which no real run is needed to see.
